title: More Netherite Variants
description: Mods that aims to add variants to netherite and some special tools
body:
**-- This mod was primarly made with the purpose of being played and enjoyed by my friend so it may not be refined and certainly has some bugs. Feel free to leave a comment if you found some but I'm not sure I'll bother fixing them --**



This mod is pretty new so there's only two netherite variant so far but more will be added in the futur. The mod is also compatible with **Tetra**.



This mod adds new type of netherite and all the tools that comes with it, and more...

Each variant comes with it's own perk related to it's other component.



**Blazed Netherite**

![Build presenting all the Blazed Netherite Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7bcbe2f0cd43e04cd243e69da4d778aeb09fd0b4.png)

![Blazed Netherite ingot crafting receipe : mix 3 blaze powder with a netherite ingot to get 1 blazed netherite ingot and the chance to get a gold ingot and/or a netherite ingot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4150c3d0fc5444c309d22c57b8994633207180db.png)

![Blazed Netherite tools description : Tool sets ennemies on fire and Tool automaticly smelts block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c500e5211d2dea6ff942c407762752e51430702.png)

![Blazed Netherite armor description : Full set grants fire immunity](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f464e57ccf4a9f192d89da20a74ef68fbc25a885.png)
